exposure: Novel heterozygous variant c.109dupC of the SLC2A1 gene
cohort: A 6-year-old girl diagnosed with Glucose transporter type 1 deficiency syndrome (GLUT1-DS) due to a novel SLC2A1 gene mutation.
finding: A 6-year-old girl with GLUT1-DS caused by a novel heterozygous variant c.109dupC of the SLC2A1 gene presented with ataxia, epilepsy, acquired microcephaly, and mild intellectual disability, showing clinical improvement with a ketogenic diet.
